Q1For OP
Topic
Points expiry
Status
Waiting for your reply
Documents
T&C 4.3 T&C 9.2 FAQ p.2
Markets
SEA (MY, TH, VN, PH, ID)
Our question
Which one applies to SEA clients today?
01The question
Hi Anna,
Do points expire?
The T&C (the 20260710 version) says unredeemed points expire after two years (4.3), and also if an account is suspended for 12 months (9.2). But the FAQ says points stay valid even if a client stops trading. Which one applies to SEA clients today?
02What the T&C says
Points expire after two years.
Two clauses in the TMGM Rewards Terms and Conditions, the 20260710 version.
Clause 4.3T&C · page 2
Points that aren't redeemed expire after two years.
Clause 9.2T&C · page 3
If all of a client's trading accounts are deactivated, or the client leaves TMGM, their store access is suspended. After 12 months of suspension, their points expire.
Open the T&C
PDF · TMGM Rewards Terms and Conditions · 20260710
03What the FAQ says
Points stay valid.
The TMGM Points Rewards FAQ says the opposite, on page 2.
The expiry questionFAQ · page 2
Points stay valid even if a client stops trading.
Open the FAQ
PDF · TMGM Points Rewards FAQ
04What we need
Which one applies to SEA clients today?
1
The T&C. Points expire after two years, and after 12 months of account suspension.
2
The FAQ. Points stay valid, even if a client stops trading.
3
Something else. For example, a different rule for some countries.
A short reply is enough, for example “1”. Until we hear back, the store pages and our content won't mention expiry at all.

Our question
Can clients withdraw it, or is it trading credit?
01The question
Can clients withdraw their cash back?
When a client swaps points for cash (for example 130 points for USD 5), does it go in as normal balance they can withdraw, or as trading credit? And is there anything they need to do before they can withdraw it?
02What the store says
It goes into the trading account they pick.
The 5 USD Cash Back page, 130 points, as clients see it today.
The rewardStore · 5 USD Cash Back
Redeem rulesStore · 5 USD Cash Back
It says when and where the cash lands, but not whether clients can withdraw it.
Open the store page
Portal login needed
03What the FAQ and T&C say
Nothing about withdrawing.
Neither document says whether cash back from points can be withdrawn, or if anything has to happen first.
Open the FAQ Open the T&C
04What we need
Where does the cash go?
1
Normal balance. Clients can withdraw it straight away.
2
Normal balance, with conditions first. For example, a trading requirement. Please tell us which.
3
Trading credit. Clients can trade with it but can't withdraw it.
A short reply is enough, for example “1”. Until we hear back, our content won't say anything about withdrawing.

Our question
Does every SEA client earn points automatically, and is anyone left out?
01The question
Does every client earn points?
Does every SEA client earn points automatically? The FAQ says points start once the reward is automatically activated, or after the client asks support or their Account Manager. And are any accounts left out of earning, for example accounts joining other promotions (T&C 3.4)?
02What the FAQ says
Points start once the reward is switched on.
On page 1 of the TMGM Points Rewards FAQ.
When earning startsFAQ · page 1
Some clients may need to ask support or their Account Manager first. It doesn't say which clients.
Open the FAQ
PDF · TMGM Points Rewards FAQ
03What the T&C says
Some accounts can be left out.
Clause 3.4, on page 2 of the T&C.
Clause 3.4T&C · page 2
For example, accounts in other TMGM promotions. It doesn't list which ones.
Open the T&C
PDF · TMGM Rewards Terms and Conditions · 20260710
04What we need
Two things to confirm.
1
Switched on for everyone? Is earning automatic for every SEA client today? If not, who has to ask?
2
Anyone left out? Which accounts can't earn points today, for example accounts in other promotions?
If some clients need to ask first, we'll add a line on the pages telling them how.

FAQ p.2 FAQ p.3 T&C 6.3

Our question
Can a client cancel a gift order after submitting it?
01The question
Can gift orders be cancelled?
FAQ page 2 says an order can't be cancelled or changed once it's submitted, but FAQ page 3 says support can cancel it before the item is bought. Which one applies?
02What FAQ page 2 says
No.
In the redemption steps.
Redemption stepsFAQ · page 2
Once an order is submitted, it can't be cancelled or changed.
03What FAQ page 3 and the T&C say
Yes, in some cases.
Page 3 of the FAQ, and clause 6.3 of the T&C.
Cancelling an orderFAQ · page 3
Support can cancel if the item hasn't been bought yet.
Clause 6.3T&C · page 3
If TMGM can't deliver, for example because the item is out of stock, the client can cancel and get the points back.
Open the FAQ Open the T&C
04What we need
Which one applies?
1
No cancelling. Once an order is submitted, it's final.
2
Cancelling through support. Clients can ask support to cancel before the item is bought.
3
Something else.
Your answer decides one line on the 15 gift pages. For now, they only say points are deducted as soon as the order is submitted.

01The message, word for word
Hi Anna,
I'd love your help with a few questions on the Reward Store (TMGM Rewards).
Some background first: Nicole Sun has asked our team to create marketing content for the Reward Store cashback in SEA (Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and the Philippines), as there isn't much content about it in our markets yet. Edwin has set this as content only, so we'll just be explaining and promoting what's already in the store, with no new campaign or terms.
I've gone through the store, the FAQ and the T&C, and aligned with Nicole on the scope. There are three things the documents don't answer clearly, and Nicole mentioned BO would be the right team to confirm them:
1
Do points expire? The T&C (the 20260710 version) says unredeemed points expire after two years (4.3), and also if an account is suspended for 12 months (9.2). But the FAQ says points stay valid even if a client stops trading. Which one applies to SEA clients today?
2
When a client swaps points for cash (for example 130 points for USD 5), does it go in as normal balance they can withdraw, or as trading credit? And is there anything they need to do before they can withdraw it?
3
Does every SEA client earn points automatically? The FAQ says points start once the reward is automatically activated, or after the client asks support or their Account Manager. And are any accounts left out of earning, for example accounts joining other promotions (T&C 3.4)?
We don't want to say anything to clients about expiry or withdrawals until we're sure, so these are the main things holding the content back.
Would you be able to help us check these? Or if it's easier on your side, please let us know if it's okay for us to reach out to BO directly, and who the best person to speak to would be.
Happy to send over the FAQ and T&C PDFs or screenshots if that helps. Thank you so much ya
